en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard framed by a printed wooden border, showing a waterfront cityscape with large, ornate buildings and several boats moored along the quay. The oval central photograph depicts the façade of a grand hotel and adjacent buildings beside a body of water, with a promenade in the foreground. Text printed below the image reads the city name and the specific buildings shown.
